Worked examples in biostatistics, bioinformatics, and computational biology — Cox models, Bayesian hierarchical methods, epidemic modeling, multi-omics integration, and whatever comes next. Each article is a full reproducible analysis: simulated or public data, R code, diagnostics, and an honest read of what the numbers do and don't support.
